priority_rules.criteria: Migraine frequency at least 15 days per month, intensity at least 9, or disabling work interruption.
Migraine frequency 8 to 14 days per month or intensity 6 to 8.
Completed response with lower current frequency and intensity plus a requested lighting accommodation.

tie_breaker: Higher intensity, then higher frequency, then earlier submitted timestamp.
decision_boundary: Department is context only and must not change clinical priority.
privacy_rule: Use case identifiers only; do not include participant names, email addresses, or tokens.
